name: Ochaco Uraraka
source:
The student of class 1A, [url=https://vndb.org/c104176]Izuku[/url]'s classmate. The cheerful but strange girl. The quirk - controlling gravity, the ability to make things weightless. Disadvantages - causes nausea when the object is heavy.
